get_conv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse convolution given kernel, stride, padding, and dilation parameters
get_deconv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse transposed convolution given kernel, stride, padding, and output padding
get_indice_pairs: build indice pairs for sparse convolution operations across 2D, 3D, or 4D spatial feature tensors
indice_conv: perform a sparse indice-based convolution forward pass on feature tensors using precomputed indice pairs and filters
indice_maxpool: perform a sparse indice-based max pooling operation on feature tensors using precomputed indice pairs
